ratios.facility: Sixth Amended Credit Agreement (Term Loan and Revolving Credit Facility)
ratios.quote: (i) a Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio not to exceed (a) 5.00 as of the end of each fiscal quarter ending July 3, 2026 through January 1, 2027

ratios.facility: Sixth Amended Credit Agreement (Term Loan and Revolving Credit Facility)
ratios.quote: (ii) a Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio of not less than (a) 2.50 as of the end of each fiscal quarter ending July 3, 2026 through June 30, 2028

parsed.notes: The actual ratios are not disclosed. The filing says only that the Company was in compliance with the covenants as of October 2, 2026. The limits shown are the ones in force for the quarter ended October 2, 2026, under the Sixth Amendment schedule. The net leverage maximum later steps down: 4.75 from April 2027, 4.50 from October 2027, 4.25 at March 2028 and 4.00 from June 2028. The interest coverage minimum rises to 2.75 from September 2028. The 3.25 Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio test for incremental loans is an incurrence condition and was excluded. Leverage-based interest margins were also excluded.
